title: French Lick Springs Hotel
geometryBasis: The 44-point named hotel footprint contains the linked elongated front, North Wing, West Wing, oblique Deluxe Wing and two-storey Spa Wing.
sectionBasis: The exact Qualla original supports the southeast profile, door and sash rhythms, veranda and yellow masonry. The National Register description distinguishes the other sections, many of which have flat roofs and limestone parapets. Original terrain fixes the lawn and hillside context.
limitations: Exact upper floor boundaries, roof materials and rear glazing placement are estimated. A representative section is used for the visible height of each documented wing.
The shared original model depicts the attached hotel ranges. The separate casino, modern event building, pools, landscape structures and independent Pluto Spring pavilion are outside this model.
